description: This file is a shell test script that automates testing for 'git fast-import' with signed tags in various formats (OpenPGP, X.509, SSH). It sets up tests for importing signed tags with different signature verification modes and checks the corresponding behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, executing the specified commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success GPG
methods.description: Runs a test with GPG signing context, verifying GPG-signed tags.

methods.name: test_expect_success GPGSM
methods.description: Runs a test with GPG/SMIME signing context, verifying X.509 signed tags.

methods.name: test_expect_success GPGSSH
methods.description: Runs a test with SSH signing context, verifying SSH signed tags.
